visit.title: Patient P-{{ref}}
visit.timersHelp: The patient check-in timer and the staff reassessment timer are separate. A patient answer never resets the staff timer.
visit.failed: This visit could not be loaded.

answers.companionOnly: The patient did not answer this check-in.

actions.title: Actions
actions.noTask: There is no open task to acknowledge or assess.
actions.ackHelp: "I've seen this." Acknowledging is not an assessment.
actions.ackFirst: Acknowledge the task before you assess it.
actions.flagHelp: Raises a review task for the physician without changing the queue.
actions.stopAppHelp: Prompts stop and the signed-in phone is signed out. The staff reassessment timer keeps running. This cannot be undone.
actions.stopAppConfirm: I understand this cannot be undone.
actions.deviceHelp: One phone is signed in at a time. To switch people or phones, show the QR again.
actions.showQrFailed: The QR could not be shown.

errors.bpOrder: Diastolic must be lower than systolic.
errors.range: A value is outside the allowed range. Check for a typo.

patient.departmentWait: The department's current estimate for new arrivals is about {{estimate}}.
patient.placeInLine: Your answers never change your place in line.

patient.languageNotice: Questions are shown in English for now. Ask a staff member if you need help in another language.
patient.signOutHelp: This phone will stop sending check-ins. The patient keeps their place in line, and anyone can sign in again by scanning the QR code.

leaving.title: Are you leaving?

urgent.queued: Your report is saved and will send when you are connected. Do not wait: tell a staff member now.

sent.title: Thank you, we have your answers
sent.queuedBody: It will send as soon as you are connected.
sent.stillChecking: Staff will still check on you on their own schedule.

message.clinician_will_check: A clinician will check on you.
message.leaving_info: Please tell staff before you leave. Return to triage right away if you feel worse.

takeover.confirm: Sign out the other phone and continue

signedOut.title: You've been signed out.

privacy.title: What we store
privacy.stored1: Your answers and when you gave them.
privacy.stored2: Your triage level and complaint group.

circle.intro: You will see shapes appear one at a time. Count the circles. Ignore the squares.

circle.watch: Watch the screen and count the circles.

flow.finishLaterHelp: If you stop, we send the answers you gave so far.
